title: Singing at home and why she sings only religious songs
summary: She sings while cooking, favors upbeat songs, and says she sacrifices singing the blues; she began singing in church at four or five.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular
